name: Mark Turnbull

summary.text: Mark Turnbull was managing director of the political division of SCL Elections/Cambridge Analytica. He was filmed alongside Alexander Nix in Channel 4 News's undercover investigation, broadcast on 19 and 20 March 2018, in which he described proxy organisations to feed negative material about opponents and said the company was not in the business of entrapment. The DCMS Committee's interim report said the company suspended him after the broadcast.

facts.claim: Channel 4 News filmed Turnbull, then managing director of SCL Elections' political division, in meetings between November 2017 and January 2018 with a reporter posing as a fixer for a prospective Sri Lankan client.
facts.quote: The meetings took place at London hotels over four months, between November 2017 and January 2018.

facts.claim: In the recordings Turnbull said the firm was 'not in the business of entrapment' and that such practices crossed a line, while also describing the use of proxy organisations such as charities or activist groups to put negative material about opposition candidates onto the internet and social media.
facts.quote: proxy organisations to discreetly feed negative material about opposition candidates

facts.claim: The DCMS interim report quoted Turnbull's description of the company's method as being that no one knew it was there: it was 'ghosted in', did the work and 'ghosted out'.
